title: The Ladder of Gathering-Inward
description: The upward ladder by which dispersed elements are gathered home: each natural quality conjoined to its purer kindred (fire to fire of fire), then to Tamr, to Answer, to Call, to the chosen Mind / Noeric, to the Pillar of Glory, to the First Man, to the Ambassador, to the aeons of the Greatness — the place of rest forever. The whole regenerative dialogue collected into its source.
